_note: Fictional product, made up for a demo. Every figure a page shows must come from this file.
what: Uptime and cron-job monitoring for small engineering teams

audience.text: Teams of 2 to 20 engineers who run their own services

cron_monitoring: Each job pings a unique URL when it finishes; a missed ping alerts after a grace period you set
status_pages: One public status page per project, on your own domain

setup.text: Paste a URL. The first check runs within 60 seconds.
